# B2 vocabulary batch 93

## Scope

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `improved`, `impulsive`, `inaccurate`, `inadequate`, `inanimate`, `inborn`, `incense`, `incurable`, `indent`, `independently`, `indescribable`, `indignity`, `indispensable`, `indulgent`, `industrialize`, `ineffective`, `inert`, `inexperienced`, `infect`, `infected`, `infectious`, `inflammation`, `inflammatory`, `influenza`, and `infringe`.

Each entry was manually reviewed for meaning, part of speech, Vietnamese gloss, example pair, IPA, level, and controlled topic assignment. Variant spellings were not duplicated.
